metric.semantic_density.raw_value_definition: explicit local semantic sites (EXPLICIT_LOCAL rows per semantic_site_matrix, scored per methodology 6.1.3) / lexical source tokens of measured_fragment, summed across all probes with a written TypeScript fragment (FULL or PARTIAL).
metric.semantic_density.tokenizer_rule: Simple language-neutral lexer: each keyword, identifier, literal, and punctuation/operator token counted once; multi-character operators/punctuators that form a single lexical token in TypeScript (e.g. =>, ===, !==, ??, |=, +=, ++, <=, >=, &&, ||) counted as one token each. Comments and whitespace excluded (none present in fragments). String/number/template literals counted as a single token each unless they contain nested expression holes, in which case each hole delimiter and interpolated sub-expression token is counted separately.
